rendered_context:
[MOTIVE_ACTION] Render competing wants and needs through choices, tactics, concessions, and costs; do not name the taxonomy in the artifact.
[VOICE_RELATION] Differentiate actors through word choice, rhythm, evasions, behavior, and relationship pressure that changes available actions.
[CAUSAL_AFFORDANCE] Select a small number of concrete sensory or mechanical affordances that constrain action, can be interacted with, and can carry a later payoff.
[PRESSURE_BEATS] Realize escalation as opposed tactics, obstacle, reaction, and reversal rather than explanatory summary.
[SETUP_PAYOFF] Plant a concrete question or affordance, preserve its dependency, and pay it off through later action inside the bounded event.
[FRAME_BRIDGE] When confirmed values exist, bridge premise, theme, tone, genre, POV, and tense without guessing or asking questions.
[DRAFT_SCENE] Produce Draft-usable spatial beats with action/reaction, resistance, reversal, and a terminal image; avoid synopsis-only realization.
[ANTI_TAXONOMY] Use capability labels only for reasoning; never emit labels such as external want, internal need, or local state change as explanatory prose.
[PLOT_CAUSAL_ESCALATION] Within the frozen event role, realize actor choice and action, causal escalation, and the resulting local state change toward resolution.
[PLOT_SETUP_PAYOFF_INTENT] Preserve deliberate setup, question, foreshadowing, and payoff intent across the plan.
[PLOT_PACING_INTENT] Pace action and progression under the frozen formal event role without changing formal chronology or ownership.
[CHARACTER_MOTIVATION] Realize external wants, internal needs, relevant biography, formative pressures, and their conflict in character action.
[CHARACTER_VOICE] Keep vocabulary, sentence shape, verbal habits, and tone distinct for referenced actors.
[CHARACTER_ARC] Connect starting state, turning points, and ending state without overriding frozen event outcomes.
[CHARACTER_RELATIONSHIP_NUANCE] Use the referenced relationship role to shape pressure, contrast, trust, and subtext without inventing authority.
[WORLD_SENSORY_SPECIFICITY] Propose concrete sensory and interactive location details that remain local to event realization.
[WORLD_COST_AND_LIMIT] When a system matters, propose specific costs, limits, consequences, and social impact without creating Canon.
[WORLD_FACTION_PRESSURE] Use faction purpose, power base, membership, and conflicts as proposal-only local pressure.
[WORLD_CURRENT_STATE] Ground realization in story-relevant history, culture, and current tensions while preserving existing authority.
[WORLD_ARTIFACT_DETAIL] Treat an artifact as a proposal-only story element with recognizable form, bounded function, relevant history, and current risk.
